verdict.rationale: Brave's docs claim AI-generated summaries/answers, LLM Context endpoints, and AI-powered location descriptions grounded on its search index (docs-16/17/27/30), suggesting AI-native insight generation. However, this is insight generated from Brave's web index, not from 'my data' inside a user's own product data, and community evidence shows the standard/free API ToS explicitly prohibits using responses for AI inference, forcing users onto a separate AI Inference plan to legally use these AI features with agents (comm-1, comm-2), directly undercutting the vendor's presentation of seamless AI-generated insight delivery. missing for 10: evidence of insights generated from a user's own proprietary/private data rather than the shared web index, and resolution of the ToS conflict for AI-inference use cases.
